spec: §15 suite D (channel and unitary comparison for epsilon > 0 realisations); §8.3: a scheme's error is the sum of its template gates' charged errors; §12.3 inclusive error composition
derivation: A scheme with two leaves whose verified operator-norm upper bounds are each 1/1000 is charged 2/1000 by §8.3. On first combination with a diamond bound, §12.3 converts it once to 4/1000. This checks accounting only: upper bounds do not imply that a tighter checker-computed claim must fail; actual unitaries and interval enclosures decide that.
